selection_rule: For each pending slot, match exact model, effort, task and repeat index to the friend report. Preserve all already-started local slots. Selection does not depend on reward, cost or error status. Import every source result; one overlapping source trial remains supplemental because its local slot already finished.
comparability_caveat: Luna baseline combines 38 historical Codex CLI 0.154.0/concurrency-4 trials with one existing local CLI 0.160.0/concurrency-3 trial. Hinted trials use CLI 0.160.0/concurrency 3. Task, instruction and grading hashes match, but client version, run date and concurrency differ: this is a descriptive comparison with historical controls, not a fully controlled estimate of hint causality. Other model conditions retain their frozen protocol.
